feeds.title: Food-Lifestyle-Facts Blog
feeds.description: My name is Rosa Lazic and I was born in Garmisch-Partenkirchen, Germany, in the late 1980s as the third child of two Serbs. The main part of my blog will be about the wholesome, plant-based nutrition, recipes, and food you should eat more often. And recommendations on food which you should try to avoid. You'll get some information about plant-based and vegetarian food.

feeds.title: More Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: The More Nutrition Blog offers a lot of interesting information on topics such as losing weight, sugar, vegan nutrition, and much more. More Nutrition provides you with only sensible dietary supplements such as protein powder, vegan products, pre-workouts, and more.

feeds.title: Foodboost
feeds.description: A tasty, well-balanced diet? Nothing could be easier! Foodboost will get you going and give you better focus, more energy, more YEAH! But how? With nothing but natural, fresh ingredients full of vital nutrients. We use these to conjure up delicious dishes that will help you reach your goals day after day. See what surprises are in store, from colorful snacks, clever lunch ideas, and special drinks. Find out how food can push you to be your best self!

feeds.title: CareElite » Nutrients
feeds.description: You want to know more about nutrients and vital substances for a healthy body? In the Nutrient Blog you can find out everything you need to know about essential nutrients.

feeds.title: Lifetimefit » Nutrition
feeds.description: The following section of Lifetimefit is dedicated to Nutrition. Hi, I'm Thorsten! I am a graduate sports scientist, and my main subjects are sports medicine and training sciences. I was a physical fitness coach in the German premier league soccer and handball. And as an author, I have published 30 books on fitness, health, and nutrition. You will regularly find new and scientifically based articles on this blog, written in an easily understandable way.

feeds.title: NutraMedix Blog
feeds.description: NutraMedix Deutschland GmbH is an independent company that specializes in the distribution of high-quality herbal dietary supplements from NutraMedix in Europe. Our mission is to provide the best possible service to individual customers, therapists, pharmacies, and wholesalers.

feeds.title: DGE German Society for Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: Since its foundation in 1953, the German Nutrition Society e. V. with all questions arising in the field of nutrition and determines the need for research. It ideally supports nutritional research, provides information about new findings and developments and makes them available through publications and events.

feeds.title: Vejo Blog
feeds.description: Vejo will help you find information and background information on the topics of nutrition, health, and well-being. Doctors and nutritionists provide in-depth knowledge in the articles for a healthy and happy lifestyle.

feeds.title: BodyFast » Nutrition
feeds.description: The following section of the BodyFast website is dedicated to Nutrition. Find articles on how to maintain proper nutrition level in your body from experts. BodyFast is the ultimate intermittent fasting app. The BodyFast Coach provides your individual weekly fasting plan and leads you quickly to your goals.
